unit_attributes.statement: A determination to terminate the designation or reduce the funding of an eligible entity is reviewable by the Secretary.
The Secretary shall, upon request, review a determination to terminate the designation or reduce the funding of an eligible entity.

The review of a determination to terminate designation or reduce funding shall be completed not later than 90 days after the Secretary receives from the State all necessary documentation relating to the determination to terminate the designation or reduce the funding.

If the review by the Secretary is not completed within 90 days after receiving from the State all necessary documentation, the determination of the State shall become final at the end of the 90th day.
unit_attributes.scope_text: If the review is not completed within 90 days

unit_attributes.statement: In a case where the Secretary provides financial assistance to an eligible entity affected because a State violated the assurances in section 9908(b)(8) and terminated or reduced funding prior to completion of the State hearing and the Secretary's review, the grant or allotment for the State under section 9905 or 9906 of this title for the earliest appropriate fiscal year shall be reduced by an amount equal to the funds provided under this subsection to such eligible entity.
